backend/main.mo: Motoko backend defining user profiles, order types, authorization checks, and CRUD operations for orders with admin and owner-based access control.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Generated summaries of various frontend files describing their roles in routing, UI, auth, and order workflows.
frontend/.env.example: Example environment variable template for local frontend development.
frontend/.env.production: Production environment variable template used during deployment.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide outlining prerequisites and steps for deploying the app to the Internet Computer.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining global theme variables, dark mode values, and base styling.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file loading the React app entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app configuring routing, auth provider, theme provider, and core page routes.
frontend/src/components/AdminGate.tsx: Route guard restricting access to admin users with loading and access-denied states.
frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx: Layout wrapper providing header, disclaimer banner, main content area, and footer.
frontend/src/components/AuthGate.tsx: Route guard enforcing authentication and redirecting users to sign in.
frontend/src/components/AuthStatusButton: Header button handling sign-in/out actions and showing current username.
frontend/src/components/BrandHeader.tsx: Header with navigation, showing dashboard/admin links based on session auth.
frontend/src/components/IdCardActions.ts: Buttons to export the ID card as PNG or print it, with toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/IdCardPreview.ts: Visual preview of an ID card including photo, personal details, and state seal.
frontend/src/components/IdWatermark.tsx: Overlay watermark marking the ID as roleplay-only.
frontend/src/components/PhotoCropModal.t: Modal for cropping an uploaded photo to a fixed aspect ratio using drag and scale controls.
frontend/src/components/PhotoUploader.ts: Drag‑and‑drop or click‑to‑upload image selector with validation and preview.
frontend/src/components/StateSeal.tsx: Displays a state seal image with fallback if the seal isn’t found.
frontend/src/constants/usStates.ts: List of US state codes and names.
frontend/src/content/copy.ts: Centralized UI text strings for disclaimers and form descriptions.
frontend/src/hooks/auth/useIsAdmin.ts: React Query hook checking if the current actor is an admin.
frontend/src/hooks/auth/useSessionAuth.t: LocalStorage‑based session auth provider handling sign‑in, sign‑up, and admin detection.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/queryKeys.ts: Shared React Query keys for orders and auth.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/useAllOrders.t: React Query hook retrieving all orders for admin users.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/useCreateOrder: Hook to create an order via actor, store its ID in localStorage, and invalidate user order queries.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/useGetOrder.ts: Hook to fetch a single order by ID using the actor, enabled only when actor and ID are available.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/useUpdateOrder: Hook to update an order's status and refresh admin and user order queries.
Hook to load the authenticated user's orders by reading stored order IDs from localStorage and fetching them individually.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor based on Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity login, identity persistence, and status management via a React context provider.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles, theme variables, animation utilities, and print rules.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering the app.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelPage.tsx: Displays all orders for admins with tools to modify order status.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Shows the user's orders and provides navigation to create or view individual orders.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page showing hero section, feature steps, and navigation to sign-in.
frontend/src/pages/NewOrderPage.tsx: Form page for creating a new ID order with photo upload, cropping, validation, and submission.
frontend/src/pages/OrderDetailPage.tsx: Displays order details, status, ID preview, and handles loading or missing-order states.
frontend/src/pages/SignInPage.tsx: Sign-in form with username/password, error handling, and navigation to dashboard or sign-up.
frontend/src/pages/SignUpPage.tsx: User registration form with validation, error display, success state, and redirect to sign-in.
frontend/src/utils/exportIdCard.ts: Exports the ID card DOM element to PNG via canvas or falls back to print mode.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Formats order status strings by capitalizing the first letter.
frontend/src/utils/stateSeals.ts: Returns the file path for a state's seal image based on its name.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash-based), persist them in sessionStorage, and clear them from the URL or session.
frontend/src/utils/username.ts: Offers simple username normalization and checks whether a username matches the fixed admin username TravvyC.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme extensions, custom colors, breakpoints, keyframes, and plugin usage.
project_state.json: Describes project requirements and state for enforcing unique usernames and ensuring only TravvyC has admin privileges.
